verses.text: Solomon spend 13 years to build im own house, and e finish all im house.
E build di House of di Forest of Lebanon. Im length na 100 cubits, and im width na 50 cubits, and im height na 30 cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on top di pillars.
Dem cover am with cedar for top, over di 45 beams wey dey on di pillars, 15 for one row.
Beams dey for three rows, and window dey face window for three levels.
All di doors and posts get square frames, and window dey face window for three levels.
E make di porch of pillars. Im length na 50 cubits, and im width na 30 cubits. One porch dey for front of dem, and pillars and one step dey for front of dem.
E make di porch of di throne wey e go use judge, di Porch of Judgment, and dem cover am with cedar from floor to floor.
Im house wey e go stay, di other court inside di porch, na di same kind work. E make house for Pharaoh daughter too, wey Solomon marry, like dis porch.
All dem ones na costly stones, shaped stones, as dem measure am, wey dem cut with saw, inside and outside, from di foundation reach di top of di wall, and so for outside reach di big court.
Di foundation na costly stones, big stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.
For top na costly stones, shaped stones as dem measure am, and cedar wood.
Di big court round get three rows of shaped stone and one row of cedar beams, like di inner court of di Lord house and di porch of di house.
King Solomon send people go bring Hiram from Tyre.

Na pikin of one widow from Naphtali tribe e be, and im papa na man from Tyre, wey dey work bronze. E full with wisdom and understanding and skill to do all kind work for bronze. E come to King Solomon and do all im work.
Because e cast di two pillars of bronze, each one na 18 cubits high, and one line of 12 cubits go round each one.
E make two tops of melted bronze to put on top of di pillars. Di height of one top na five cubits, and di height of di other top na five cubits.
Nets of checker work and chains like wreath dey for di tops wey dey on top of di pillars, seven for one top and seven for di other top.
So e make di pillars, and two rows dey round one network to cover di tops wey dey on top of di pillars, and na so e do for di other top.
Di tops wey dey on top of di pillars for di porch na lily work, four cubits.
Tops dey for top of di two pillars too, near di round part wey dey beside di network, and di pomegranates na 200, for rows round di other top.
E set up di pillars for di porch of di temple. E set up di right pillar and call im name Jachin, and e set up di left pillar and call im name Boaz.
For top of di pillars na lily work. So dem finish di work of di pillars.
E make di melted sea, ten cubits from one edge to di other, round, and im height na five cubits, and one line of 30 cubits go round am.
Under im edge, buds dey round am for ten cubits, dem dey go round di sea completely. Di buds dey for two rows, dem cast dem as dem cast di sea.
E stand on 12 oxen, three dey face north, three dey face west, three dey face south, and three dey face east. Dem set di sea on top of dem, and all dem back parts dey inside.
E thick like one hand width, and im edge dey like edge of cup, like lily flower. E fit carry 2,000 baths.
E make di ten bases of bronze. Four cubits na di length of one base, and four cubits na im width, and three cubits na im height.
Na so di work of di bases be: dem get panels, and borders dey between di ledges.
On di panels wey dey between di ledges na lions, oxen and cherubim, and for di ledges one stand dey for top. Under di lions and oxen na wreaths of hanging work.
Every base get four bronze wheels and bronze axles, and im four feet get supports. Under di basin na supports wey dem cast, with wreaths for di side of each one.
Im mouth inside di top and for up na one cubit, and im mouth round like work of stand, one and half cubits. Carvings dey on im mouth too, and dem panels square, no round.
Di four wheels dey under di panels, and di axles of di wheels dey inside di base. Di height of one wheel na one and half cubits.
Di work of di wheels na like work of chariot wheel. Dem axles, and dem rims, and dem spokes, and dem hubs, all na melted metal.
Four supports dey for di four corners of each base. Im supports come from di base imself.
For top of di base na one round band wey high half cubit, and for top of di base im stays and im panels na di same piece.
On di plates of im stays and on im panels e carve cherubim, lions and palm trees, as di space of each one be, with wreaths round.
Na so e make di ten bases. All of dem get one casting, one measure and one shape.
E make ten basins of bronze. One basin fit carry 40 baths, and every basin na four cubits, and one basin dey on every one of di ten bases.
E set di bases, five for di right side of di house and five for di left side of di house, and e set di sea for di right side of di house, for east, toward di south.
Hiram make di pots, and di shovels, and di basins. So Hiram finish all di work wey e work for King Solomon for di Lord house:
di two pillars, and di two bowls of di tops wey dey on top of di pillars, and di two networks to cover di two bowls of di tops wey dey on top of di pillars,
and di 400 pomegranates for di two networks, two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover di two bowls of di tops wey dey on di pillars,
and di ten bases, and di ten basins wey dey on di bases,
and di one sea, and di 12 oxen under di sea,
and di pots, and di shovels, and di basins. All dem things wey Hiram make for King Solomon for di Lord house na polished bronze.
Di king cast dem for di plain of Jordan, for di clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
Solomon no weigh all di things, because dem plenty well well. Nobody fit know di weight of di bronze.
Solomon make all di things wey dey di Lord house: di gold altar, and di gold table wey di bread of di presence dey on,
and di lampstands, five for di right side and five for di left, for front of di inner sanctuary, na pure gold, and di flowers, and di lamps, and di tongs, na gold,

and di cups, and di snuffers, and di basins, and di spoons, and di fire pans, na pure gold, and di hinges, both for di doors of di inner house, di Most Holy Place, and for di doors of di house, di temple, na gold.

So all di work wey King Solomon do for di Lord house finish. Solomon bring in di things wey im papa David don give to God, di silver, and di gold, and di things, and put dem for di treasuries of di Lord house.

Den Solomon gather di elders of Israel, and all di heads of di tribes, di leaders of di families of Israel pikin dem, to King Solomon for Jerusalem, to bring up di ark of di covenant of di Lord from David city, wey be Zion.
All di men of Israel gather to King Solomon for di feast, for di month Ethanim, wey be di seventh month.
All di elders of Israel come, and di priests carry di ark.
Dem bring up di ark of di Lord, and di Tent of Meeting, and all di holy things wey dey di Tent. Na di priests and di Levites bring dem up.
King Solomon and all di people of Israel wey gather to am dey with am before di ark, dey make sacrifice of sheep and oxen wey nobody fit count because dem plenty.
Di priests bring di ark of di covenant of di Lord enter im place, enter di inner sanctuary of di house, di Most Holy Place, under di wings of di cherubim.
Because di cherubim spread dem wings over di place of di ark, and di cherubim cover di ark and im poles from up.
Di poles long so tay dem see di ends of di poles from di holy place for front of di inner sanctuary, but dem no see dem for outside. And dem dey there till today.
Nothing dey inside di ark except di two stone tablets wey Moses put there for Horeb, as di Lord make covenant with Israel pikin dem as dem comot from Egypt land.
E happen as di priests comot from di holy place, say di cloud fill di Lord house,
so tay di priests no fit stand do dem work because of di cloud, because di glory of di Lord fill di Lord house.
Den Solomon talk say, “Di Lord don talk say e go stay inside thick darkness.
I don build house for you to stay, one place for you to stay forever.”
Di king turn im face and bless all di people of Israel wey gather, and all di people of Israel dey stand.
E talk say, “Make dem bless di Lord, di God of Israel, wey talk with im mouth to your papa David, and don finish am with im hand, say,

‘From di day wey I bring my people Israel comot from Egypt, I no choose any city from all di tribes of Israel to build house, so that my name go dey there, but I choose David to rule my people Israel.’
Now e dey for my papa David heart to build house for di name of di Lord, di God of Israel.
But di Lord talk to my papa David say, ‘As e dey your heart to build house for my name, you do well say e dey your heart.
But still, you no go build di house, but your pikin wey go come from your body, na im go build di house for my name.’

Di Lord don make im word stand wey e talk, because I don rise for my papa David place, and I sit for di throne of Israel, as di Lord promise, and I don build di house for di name of di Lord, di God of Israel.
I don set place there for di ark, wey di covenant of di Lord dey inside, wey e make with our papa dem as e bring dem comot from Egypt land.”
Solomon stand before di altar of di Lord, for front of all di people of Israel, and spread im hands toward heaven,
and e talk say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, no God dey like you, for heaven up or for earth down, wey dey keep covenant and mercy with your servants wey dey waka before you with all dem heart,
wey don keep wetin you promise your servant, my papa David. Yes, you talk with your mouth, and you don finish am with your hand, as e be today.

So now, di Lord, di God of Israel, keep wetin you promise your servant, my papa David, say, ‘Man no go fail to sit for Israel throne before me, if only your pikin dem take care of dem way, to waka before me as you don waka before me.’
So now, God of Israel, make your word stand, wey you talk to your servant, my papa David.
“But God go really stay for earth? Look, heaven and di highest heaven no fit hold you, how much less dis house wey I don build!
Still, look at di prayer of your servant and im cry for mercy, di Lord my God, to listen to di cry and to di prayer wey your servant dey pray before you today,
so that your eyes go dey open toward dis house night and day, toward di place wey you talk about say, ‘My name go dey there,’ to listen to di prayer wey your servant go pray toward dis place.
Listen to di cry of your servant and of your people Israel, as dem go pray toward dis place. Yes, hear for heaven, your place to stay, and as you hear, forgive.
“If man sin against im neighbor, and dem put oath on am to make am swear, and e come swear before your altar for dis house,
den hear for heaven, and act, and judge your servants, find di wicked guilty, to bring im way on im own head, and show say di righteous no get fault, to give am as im righteousness be.
“As your people Israel lose for front of di enemy because dem sin against you, if dem turn come back to you and confess your name, and pray and cry to you for mercy for dis house,
den hear for heaven, and forgive di sin of your people Israel, and bring dem back to di land wey you give dem papa dem.
“As di sky close and rain no fall because dem sin against you, if dem pray toward dis place, and confess your name, and turn from dem sin as you punish dem,

den hear for heaven, and forgive di sin of your servants and of your people Israel, as you teach dem di good way wey dem suppose waka, and send rain on your land wey you don give your people as inheritance.
“If hunger dey for di land, if sickness dey spread, if dem get blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar, if dem enemy surround dem for di land of dem cities, any plague or any sickness wey dey,
any prayer and cry for mercy wey any man make, or all your people Israel, as each one go know di pain of im own heart, and spread im hands toward dis house,
den hear for heaven, your place to stay, and forgive, and act, and give every man as all im ways be, di one wey you know im heart, because na only you know di hearts of all man pikin dem,
so that dem go fear you all di days wey dem dey live for di land wey you give our papa dem.
“Again, about di foreigner wey no be from your people Israel, as e go come from far country because of your name,
because dem go hear about your big name and your strong hand and your stretched out arm, as e go come and pray toward dis house,

hear for heaven, your place to stay, and do all wetin di foreigner call you for, so that all di peoples of di earth go know your name, to fear you as your people Israel dey do, and so that dem go know say dem dey call dis house wey I don build by your name.
“If your people go out to battle against dem enemy, for any way wey you go send dem, and dem pray to di Lord toward di city wey you choose and toward di house wey I don build for your name,
den hear dem prayer and dem cry for mercy for heaven, and defend dem cause.
“If dem sin against you, because nobody dey wey no dey sin, and you vex with dem and give dem to di enemy, so that dem carry dem go as prisoners to di enemy land, far or near,

but if dem think am for di land wey dem carry dem go as prisoners, and turn come back and cry to you for mercy for di land of dem wey carry dem go, say, ‘We don sin and we don do wrong, we don do wickedness,’

if dem return to you with all dem heart and with all dem soul for di land of dem enemies wey carry dem go as prisoners, and pray to you toward dem land wey you give dem papa dem, di city wey you choose and di house wey I don build for your name,
den hear dem prayer and dem cry for mercy for heaven, your place to stay, and defend dem cause,
and forgive your people wey sin against you, and all dem wrong wey dem do against you, and make dem get mercy before dem wey carry dem go as prisoners, so that dem go show dem mercy,
because na your people dem be, and your inheritance, wey you bring comot from Egypt, from inside di iron furnace,
so that your eyes go dey open to di cry for mercy of your servant and to di cry for mercy of your people Israel, to listen to dem any time wey dem cry to you.
Because you separate dem from all di peoples of di earth to be your inheritance, as you talk by Moses your servant, as you bring our papa dem comot from Egypt, di Lord God.”
E happen say as Solomon finish to pray all dis prayer and cry for mercy to di Lord, e stand up from before di altar of di Lord, from kneel on im knees with im hands spread toward heaven.
E stand and bless all di people of Israel wey gather with loud voice, say,
“Make dem bless di Lord, wey don give rest to im people Israel, as all wetin e promise, no even one word of all im good promise wey e promise by Moses im servant don fail.
Make di Lord our God dey with us, as e dey with our papa dem. Make e no leave us or abandon us,
so that e go turn our hearts to am, to waka for all im ways, and to keep im commands, and im laws, and im rules, wey e command our papa dem.
Make dis my words, wey I use cry for mercy before di Lord, dey near di Lord our God day and night, so that e go defend di cause of im servant and di cause of im people Israel, as every day go need,
so that all di peoples of di earth go know say di Lord imself na God, nobody else dey.
So make your heart dey complete with di Lord our God, to waka for im laws and to keep im commands, as e dey today.”
Di king and all Israel wey dey with am offer sacrifice before di Lord.
Solomon offer for di peace sacrifice wey e offer to di Lord 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep. So di king and all Israel pikin dem dedicate di Lord house.

Di same day di king make di middle of di court holy wey dey for front of di Lord house, because na there e offer di burnt sacrifice, and di grain sacrifice, and di fat of di peace sacrifice, because di bronze altar wey dey before di Lord too small to hold di burnt sacrifice, and di grain sacrifice, and di fat of di peace sacrifice.
So Solomon hold di feast for dat time, and all Israel with am, one big gathering, from di entrance of Hamath reach di stream of Egypt, before di Lord our God, seven days and seven days, 14 days.
For di eighth day e send di people go, and dem bless di king and go dem tents with joy and gladness of heart for all di goodness wey di Lord show David im servant and Israel im people.
E happen as Solomon finish to build di Lord house and di king house and all wetin Solomon want wey e happy to do,
say di Lord appear to Solomon di second time, as e appear to am for Gibeon.

Di Lord talk to am say, “I don hear your prayer and your cry for mercy wey you make before me. I don make dis house wey you build holy, to put my name there forever, and my eyes and my heart go dey there always.
As for you, if you go waka before me as your papa David waka, with honest heart and with good character, to do all wetin I command you, and keep my laws and my rules,
den I go make di throne of your kingdom over Israel stand forever, as I promise your papa David say, ‘Man no go fail to sit for Israel throne.’
But if una turn away from follow me, you or your pikin dem, and no keep my commands and my laws wey I set before una, but go serve other gods and worship dem,
den I go cut Israel off from di land wey I don give dem, and dis house wey I don make holy for my name, I go throw am out of my sight, and Israel go become proverb and joke among all peoples.
Even though dis house high so, everybody wey pass am go shock and go whistle, and dem go talk say, ‘Why di Lord do dis kind thing to dis land and to dis house?’
Dem go answer say, ‘Because dem leave di Lord dem God, wey bring dem papa dem comot from Egypt land, and hold other gods, and worship dem and serve dem. So di Lord don bring all dis evil on dem.’”
E happen after 20 years, as Solomon don build di two houses, di Lord house and di king house,
and Hiram king of Tyre don give Solomon cedar trees and cypress trees and gold, as all e want, say den King Solomon give Hiram 20 cities for Galilee land.
Hiram come out from Tyre to see di cities wey Solomon give am, and dem no please am.
E talk say, “Wetin be dis cities wey you give me, my brother?” E call dem di land of Cabul till today.
Hiram send 120 talents of gold to di king.
Na dis be di reason for di forced work wey King Solomon raise: to build di Lord house, and im own house, and Millo, and di wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
Pharaoh king of Egypt don go up and take Gezer and burn am with fire, and kill di Canaanites wey dey stay for di city, and give am as gift to im pikin, Solomon wife.
Solomon build Gezer, and di lower Beth Horon,
and Baalath, and Tamar for di wilderness, for di land,

and all di store cities wey Solomon get, and di cities for im chariots, and di cities for im horsemen, and wetin Solomon want to build for im pleasure for Jerusalem, and for Lebanon, and for all di land wey im rule cover.
As for all di people wey remain of di Amorites, di Hittites, di Perizzites, di Hivites and di Jebusites, wey no be from Israel pikin dem,
dem pikin dem wey remain after dem for di land, wey Israel pikin dem no fit finish completely, Solomon raise forced workers from dem till today.
But from Israel pikin dem Solomon no make anybody forced worker, because dem be di men of war, and im servants, and im leaders, and im captains, and di rulers of im chariots and of im horsemen.
Dis na di chief officers wey dey over Solomon work, 550, wey dey rule di people wey dey labor for di work.
But Pharaoh daughter come up from David city go im house wey Solomon build for am. Den e build Millo.
Solomon dey offer burnt sacrifice and peace sacrifice for di altar wey e build for di Lord three times for year, dey burn incense with dem for di altar wey dey before di Lord. So e finish di house.
King Solomon make fleet of ships for Ezion Geber, wey dey beside Eloth, for di shore of di Red Sea, for Edom land.
Hiram send im servants for di fleet, sailors wey know di sea, to go with Solomon servants.
Dem reach Ophir and carry gold from there, 420 talents, and bring am come to King Solomon.
As di queen of Sheba hear about Solomon fame concerning di name of di Lord, e come to test am with hard questions.
E come to Jerusalem with very big group, with camels wey carry spices, and plenty gold, and precious stones. As e reach Solomon, e talk with am about all wetin dey im heart.
Solomon answer all im questions. Nothing dey wey hide from di king wey e no explain to am.
As di queen of Sheba see all Solomon wisdom, and di house wey e build,

and di food for im table, and how im servants dey sit, and how im ministers dey serve, and dem clothes, and im cup bearers, and di stairs wey e dey use go up to di Lord house, no strength remain for am again.
E talk to di king say, “Na true report I hear for my own land about your works and your wisdom.
But I no believe di words until I come and my eyes see am. And look, dem no even tell me half! Your wisdom and your prosperity pass di fame wey I hear.
Happy dey your men, happy dey dis your servants wey dey stand before you always and hear your wisdom.
Make dem bless di Lord your God, wey delight for you and set you for Israel throne, because di Lord love Israel forever, so e make you king to do justice and righteousness.”
E give di king 120 talents of gold, and very plenty spices and precious stones. Spice like wetin di queen of Sheba give King Solomon no come again.
Hiram fleet wey bring gold from Ophir bring very plenty almug trees and precious stones from Ophir too.
Di king use di almug trees make pillars for di Lord house and for di king house, and harps and string instruments for di singers. Almug trees like dat no come, and dem no see dem till today.
King Solomon give di queen of Sheba all wetin e want, anything wey e ask, apart from wetin Solomon give am from im royal kindness. So e turn go im own land, e and im servants.
Di weight of gold wey come to Solomon for one year na 666 talents of gold,
apart from wetin di traders and merchants bring, and all di kings of Arabia and di governors of di country.
King Solomon make 200 big shields of beaten gold. 600 shekels of gold dey go for one shield.
E make 300 small shields of beaten gold. Three minas of gold dey go for one shield, and di king put dem for di House of di Forest of Lebanon.
Di king make big throne of ivory too, and cover am with di best gold.
Six steps dey go di throne, and di top of di throne round for back, and arms dey for each side by di place of di seat, and two lions dey stand beside di arms.
12 lions dey stand there for one side and for di other side for di six steps. Nothing like am dey make for any kingdom.
All King Solomon drinking cups na gold, and all di things for di House of di Forest of Lebanon na pure gold. None na silver, dem no count silver as anything for Solomon days.
Because di king get ships of Tarshish for sea with Hiram ships. One time for every three years di ships of Tarshish dey come, dey bring gold, and silver, ivory, and monkeys, and peacocks.
So King Solomon pass all di kings of di earth for riches and for wisdom.
All di earth dey look for Solomon face to hear im wisdom, wey God put for im heart.
Every man bring im gift, things of silver and things of gold, and clothes, and weapons, and spices, horses and mules, as dem dey do am year by year.
Solomon gather chariots and horsemen. E get 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, wey e put for di chariot cities and with di king for Jerusalem.
Di king make silver dey Jerusalem like stones, and e make cedars dey like di sycamore trees wey dey di low land, because dem plenty.
Di horses wey Solomon get na from Egypt dem bring dem come, and di king merchants dey receive dem for groups, each group for price.

One chariot dey come up and go out of Egypt for 600 shekels of silver, and one horse for 150. And na so dem dey bring dem out for all di kings of di Hittites and for di kings of Syria through dem hand.
